projects.title: MY PROJECTS
project.one.p: The To-Do app was implemented using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The code includes DOM manipulation, event handling, and interaction with LocalStorage.
project.two.p: Contact search was implemented using React. The code involves working with the useState hook, array methods, regular expressions, event handling, props, and props destructuring.
project.three.p: Post creation was implemented using React and Redux. The code works with global state: state, actions, switch-case in the reducer, useDispatch to dispatch specific action types and pass a payload, and useSelector to access state in the component. Users can create posts and update comments/likes by +1 or -1.
project.four.p: The Sign-in/Sign-up form was built using React, React-Router and styled-components. The code uses hooks like useState and useEffect, handles data in LocalStorage, filters input values using regular expressions, and styles the form conditionally based on props via styled-components. Due to the complexity of prop conditions, a switch-case approach is used for styling.
project.five.p: The timer was implemented in React using class components. The code includes working with the Date object, binding context (this) using the .bind method, and handling lifecycle methods in class components.
project.six.p: The musical event listener was implemented using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The code handles events and DOM manipulation. All songs are stored in an object, and when event.key matches an object key, the corresponding song is played using audio.play().
